topic: Your rear defroster comes on but the glass never fully clears
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Your rear defroster comes on... but the glass never fully clears.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a foggy rear windshield from inside a parked car, faint defrost grid lines barely visible under the condensation, cool early-morning light, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: Most of it clears. One thin band stays fogged, every single time.
beats.visualPrompt: Time-lapse-style shot of the same rear windshield as most of the fog clears in even horizontal bands, except one thin band in the middle that stays stubbornly fogged; slow push-in on the fogged band.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: those are heating grid lines baked onto the glass — and one line can break while the rest keep working.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a removed or bench-mounted piece of rear glass showing the thin defrost grid lines up close, one line visibly interrupted by a hairline gap, warm shop lighting, slow pan along the grid.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: A scraper, cargo, even corrosion at a connector can snap just one line.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a defroster connector tab at the edge of the glass, faint corrosion/discoloration visible, shallow depth of field.

beats.narration: Don't guess the whole thing is dead. A multimeter can find the exact break.
beats.visualPrompt: Multimeter probes touching two points along a single grid line, screen showing a reading; cut to the same test on a different line showing no continuity, tool mounted/clipped in frame.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before you replace more than you need to. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
beats.postCompositing: Real logo and CTA text overlay added in post via ffmpeg, never AI-generated.

approvedSoftLanguageUsed: stop by and we'll take a look

evidence.note: General automotive-repair knowledge (rear defroster is a resistive grid of thin lines; one line can break from a scraper, cargo, or connector corrosion while the rest keep working; a multimeter continuity/resistance test can locate the break), not a shop-specific sourced fact.
